figures.caption: Fig. 1. Comparison of the three speech production modes. The production chain (top to bottom) is intact for vocalized speech, breaks at articulation for attempted speech, and weakens at motor drive for imagined speech. Only vocalized speech yields an acoustic target for supervision; attempted speech (our setting) requires synthesizing pseudo-speech targets.

Fig. 2. Brain2Speech-Net architecture for single-stage neural-to-speech synthesis using a phoneme-informed bottleneck and a deep-HMM alignment to VITS encoder representations. The solid lines represent the data flow path during both train and inference, the dotted lines are data paths used only during training
